scientific_integrity: The palindromic spectrum and eventual defect are justified by a proved globally exhaustive pair-block cover, a reproducible finite comparison, and a central-factor argument; computation alone on an arbitrary prefix would not prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification applies only to the specified binary coding of the four-state fixed point. The finite cover is exhaustive for factors of lengths at most 18; the infinite conclusion additionally uses the central-palindrome obstruction. Unindexed historical priority cannot be guaranteed. No independent external audit has been performed.
title: The complete palindromic spectrum of a meta-automatic binary word
